newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares ease, WIG estimated down 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares ease, WIG estimated down 0.2 pct.

text.p: 0935 GMT - Polish shares extended Tuesday's slight fall but buying was stronger at order balancing after price fixing, early unofficial results showed.
Reuter calculations based on the preliminary figures showed the main market's all-share WIG index down 0.2 percent to about 15,060 points as losers led gainers by 32 to 29 with 24 stocks stable.
On the parallel market 11 stocks rose, seven fell and six were flat.
Mass privatisation NFI units were flat at 138 zlotys. The NIF index was estimated down 1.8 percent to 136.5 points.
* At 1000 GMT buying was stronger at the main market's order-balancing session still under way with 52 stocks showing greater demand and 31 greater supply.
* The biggest losers were: BWR (6.7 pct), Polfa Kutno (6.5 pct), Farm Food (4.7 pct), BPH (4.4 pct), Forte (3.7 pct), Zasada (3.0 pct), Optimus (2.8 pct) and WBK (2.7 pct).
* The top gainers were: ComputerLand (4.9 pct), Drosed (4.1 pct), Bank Handlowy (3.9 pct), Kruszwica (3.5 pct), Impexmetal (3.4 pct) and KPBP Bick (3.0 pct).
